decisions.reason: The source directly extends easy bowl removal to sanitation and potential retail use, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY containing those scope contexts.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing hidden liquid traps, removable cleaning components, sanitation, and retail-use scope.
The sanitation and removable-component decision does not change the existing requirement for controlling splashing during mixing.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing food-safe material standards and sanitation and retail-use scope.
Food-service cleaning and removable-component considerations do not alter electrical load capacity or continuous-operation reliability.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing required liquid-electrical separation and the sanitation and retail-use scope extension.
Easy whisk removal for cleaning affects the separate removal mechanism, not whisk-head size, material, style, or operating position.
The source does not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the previously selected 2.5-quart size.
Cleaning, sanitation, and removable-component considerations do not change the required smooth and frothy mixing result.
The source requests sanitation and maintenance accessibility but does not alter base stability or upper-tower vibration control.
The source contains no change to motor speed limits, adjustment range, or independent speed-control behavior.
Separation between liquids and electrical components does not change the selected 120V power architecture, supply capacity, or controller ratings.
